lede: Digits likelihood falls, then the inverse samples stay broken. Fashion, trained on grayscale images, reaches test BPD 3.263, and its prior samples stay soft garment blobs.
title: Multi-scale RealNVP
question: Does the coupling flow assign high likelihood to grayscale MNIST and invert into recognizable samples?
process: The model is a convolutional RealNVP. A checkerboard-style mask holds one part fixed and two heads predict scale and shift, y = m·x + (1−m)·(x·exp(s) + t), with s bounded by scale·tanh. The log-determinant sums s only on the changed coordinates. Multi-scale squeezes space into channels and factors half of them out at 14×14 and at 7×7. Pixels in [0, 1] are dequantized and logit-transformed. The recorded search is 2 trials and 1 epoch on digits (hidden 64, 4 layers, scale 2, lr 0.001). The digits train stage ran 20 epochs and wrote loss, bits-per-dimension, and inverse-sample plots. It did not write evaluation JSON. Fashion used those same hyperparameters on grayscale Fashion-MNIST, 60,000 train images and 10,000 test images, for 20 epochs. That run wrote the fashion checkpoint, the two curves, the prior-sample grid, evaluation JSON, and a reconstruction grid.

opening.summary: The digits train plot shows negative log-likelihood and bits per dimension falling, then flattening, with the test curve under the train curve. The only numeric likelihood on disk for digits is the search: validation BPD 1.583 after one epoch. Fashion has a full score: test BPD falls from 3.582 to 3.263.

marks.label: Inverse samples, Fashion
marks.answers: What didn't turn out as expected?
marks.summary: Samples are draws from the standard normal pushed through the inverse flow. A few cells suggest a shirt, a trouser leg, a bag, or a boot. Most are smeared gray masses on black. Likelihood moved; the prior samples did not become a clothing set.
marks.frameCaption: 64 inverse-flow samples from the Fashion train.

marks.label: Reconstructions, Fashion
marks.valueText: test clothes stay sharp after the inverse
marks.summary: Encoding eight Fashion test images and inverting the flow returns the boot, the shirt, the trousers, and the plaid. The inverse is not dropping the image. Unconditional samples are soft because those draws never passed through a real garment.
marks.frameCaption: Fashion test images above, the same images after encode-and-invert below.

marks.label: Test evaluation, Fashion
marks.answers: Why do you think the results might not be great?
marks.summary: evaluation_test_fashion.json records bin-center test NLL 1773.2 and BPD 3.263 on 10,000 images. Train is 1763.6 and 3.245 on 60,000. The curve's last test point is the same 3.263. That is a held-out score, and it is still a coarse density: the prior samples do not become clothes.

reflection.worked: Coupling layers, the masked log-determinant, and the two squeeze scales are in the model. The digits train reduces bits per dimension before the curve flattens. Fashion does the same, from test BPD 3.582 at epoch 1 to 3.263 at epoch 20. Encoding real Fashion images and inverting the flow returns sharp clothes, so the inverse itself runs.
reflection.unexpected: Prior samples stay broken on both sets: stroke fragments on digits, soft gray garment blobs on Fashion. The digits search file and the digits train plots are different runs, and the digits test JSON never landed.
reflection.why: A short search cannot place a 28×28 density on either manifold. Dequantization and the logit transform let likelihood improve by explaining background and a rough silhouette while individual glyphs and garments stay off-manifold. The Fashion reconstructions show the coupling inverse preserves a real image, so the blurry grid is the prior, not a broken inverse. Twenty epochs on the digits hyperparameters is still a short fit, and Fashion was not given its own search.
reflection.improve: Write the missing digits evaluation_test.json so that run has a held-out number beside the tune. Give Fashion its own search, then train longer, and keep the reconstruction grid next to the prior samples. If BPD keeps falling while prior samples stay soft and reconstructions stay sharp, add capacity before debugging the masked log-det.
